text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Phew... All done, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Man, you sure put together a brutal training menu, didn't ya?
choice_data_list: Because I knew you could do it, Luck.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so? Then I'll take that as a sign of your trust—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...One more lap, haah!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I can't believe this. She's been runnin' non-stop, but her fighting spirit hasn't faded one bit.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You can't help but be captivated by something like that.
I'm sure everyone else feels the same—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just as I thought. Yep, yep,
I totally get it, Marche-chan! I know the feeling!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Haaah, whew... A-All right.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe-saaan!
Mind if I join you?!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm surprised.
To think Marche-chan would do that of her own accord..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, what're we doin'?
Just standing back with our arms crossed, taking it easy..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I'm losing at this!
Trainer-san,
can I go join in too?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I realized that if I wanna be the "star attraction,"
there's still so, so much more I gotta do!
choice_data_list: What you need to do right now is rest.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Following her example,
I'm gonna seize this chance too!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe-san, Marche-chan!
Mind if I join your practice run, too?!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: B-But...
choice_data_list: Overwork just leads to injuries, you know.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Not rushing is a kind of patience too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~...
Marche-chan completely swept me off my feet.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not gonna lose either.
...Do your best, Marche-chan.
